name: request-id
description: Reusable middleware workflow. Ensures every request carries a correlation ID: reuses the caller's X-Request-Id header when present, otherwise mints a UUID, and publishes it at ctx.state.requestId for downstream steps (and response bodies) to reference. Apply via `trigger.http.middleware: ["request-id"]` — 04-multi-tenant-router does exactly that — or process-wide via BLOK_GLOBAL_MIDDLEWARE=request-id, which is the setup 15-hello-with-global-middleware demonstrates. Middleware runs on the parent ctx, so the published slot is visible to the main workflow's steps.
